title: His years on the New York police force
summary: He served six or seven years on the NYPD, even while working with Ella, and Zoot teases about his .45.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: He's always getting after me because of my pistol. You still got that big old .45? Yeah, I'm carrying it with me everywhere I go. Because I was on the force there in New York at one time, you know.
No, I didn't know that. No, I sure didn't.
Oh, it was during the time before I went out, even with Ella, I was on the force. But I didn't let them know about -- I was going out. I was on sick leave quite often.
How funny. How long did you do that, a couple of years?
Oh, yeah. Well, it was more than that.
Six or seven. I forgot about it.
Well, so you know that Gene Ramey talks a bit nuts in a way, gets ideas, yeah.
That's something. So Zoot kids you about packing your .45, huh?
Oh, yes, that's the first thing he says when he sees me now. I say, 'It's on my hip back here.' I've nothing on my hip but my wallet.
